query: What pre-specified rule will collapse rare strata (minimum n threshold) to avoid data-driven aggregation and maintain inferential validity?

response.query: What pre-specified rule will collapse rare strata (minimum n threshold) to avoid data-driven aggregation and maintain inferential validity?
response.answer: To avoid data-driven aggregation, a minimum n threshold rule collapses rare strata in statistical analysis. This maintains inferential validity by preventing over-reliance on small sample sizes. The threshold is pre-specified to ensure consistency.
